summary: Progression engine verified end-to-end. All 6 unit tests in tests/test_progression.py PASS. All 4 new E2E tests in tests/test_progression_e2e.py PASS against live backend. Concrete evidence of real progression: Speed Bench W1=112 lbs → W3=124 lbs (+10.7%, matches Intro deStep 0.05×2wks). Verified numerically that week-over-week loads escalate by the phase's deStep, deloads flag isDeload with DELOAD_LOAD_MULT=0.90 and DELOAD_VOLUME_MULT=0.60, ME rotation cycles through injury-filtered ROTATION_POOLS, DE Speed Bench does not rotate, and Peaking loads > Intro loads for the same movement.
